pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit diffuse, low-contrast edge gradients and irregular, non-geometric silhouettes. The spatial area of these patches is low relative to the surrounding light pelage, resulting in a mottled rather than tessellated appearance.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network consists of high-luminance, continuous pathways of extreme pixel-width. Junction nodes are poorly defined as the width of the light-colored corridors frequently exceeds the diameter of the adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The cervical mane presents a continuous 1D profile of short, vertical extensions, creating a low-amplitude, fine-textured serrated silhouette against the high-luminance background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural discontinuity is visible at the posterior cervical junction where the mane height abruptly decreases to the level of the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent nodular protrusion is visible on the ventral midline. The lower flank and abdominal regions exhibit extensive greyish textural mottling and increased pixel-level granularity compared to the mid-flank pelage.
